name: Erika Chougasaki
source:
Kou and Homuha’s childhood friend. Since her father is the principal of St. Joseph’s Academy, she is allowed to skip classes and spend all day in her personal computer lab. As an introvert, her hobbies include anime, videogames, and homoeroticism. Everyone considers her a computer genius just because she knows her way around a torrent client.

[From [url=http://homuha.weebly.com/]official site[/url]]

Voiced by Jane Redd.
